$comment: Hard marginal gzip budgets in KiB for splitting-aware production ESM. Each route adds one anchored component to the representative application shell in $baseline; only the entry and its transitively static chunks count as initial, while dynamic first-open chunks remain part of the separate total-cost budgets. Ceilings may use fractional KiB when they resolve to positive whole safe integer bytes. The final live-description routes measure color-picker 21,817 bytes, combobox 25,776 bytes, date-input 30,736 bytes, and select 22,338 bytes; their reviewed ceilings are 22, 26, 31, and 22 KiB respectively. Usage-badge measures 3,216 initial bytes after its nonmodal overlay runtime is deferred while eager cancellation and activation ordering remain available; its 3,264-byte ceiling retains 48 bytes of headroom. Each changed initial ceiling stays below 4% headroom.
